dct_description_sm: Polygon Feature Class of the representation of the paved surface on which aircraft take off and land, including the Airport Terminal Apron within the Kingston Airport (formerly Norman Rogers Airport) and the Gananoque Airport. This data is updated with the most recent Imagery (Nearmap) acquisition (Spring/Fall). General Presentation, General Analysis.
